item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 05/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. It will be generally fine and dry with slightly cooler mornings over the region. The monsoon is expected to persist over southern China early next week. Tropical Cyclone Yinxing will intensify gradually and move towards the vicinity of Luzon Strait in the next couple of days. It will then have a higher chance to turn westwards and enter the central and northern parts of the South China Sea. Under the influence of the dry northeast monsoon, Yinxing is expected to weaken. However, under the combined effect of the northeast monsoon and Yinxing, it will be windy over the south China coastal waters during the weekend and early next week.
